speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the 6-month history of significant weight loss despite a good appetite is concerning. Given your age and these symptoms, have you noticed any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or any lumps in your neck, armpit, or groin? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Patient denies any chronic illnesses or prior hospitalizations. Social history: Retired engineer; denies tobacco use or illicit drug use. Drinks alcohol socially.

text:
The patient denies fevers, night sweats, or bleeding, but your history of significant weight loss, fatigue, leukocytosis, and anemia remains highly concerning for a hematologic malignancy like Chronic Myeloid Leukemia or a lymphoma.
